units.source_text: 自此以后，匂亲王不能自由赴二条院去。

en.t: From then on, Prince Niou could no longer go freely to the Nijo residence.

units.source_text: 只因身份高贵，故昼间未便任意出门，

en.t: Because his rank was so high, it was inconvenient for him to go out as he pleased during the day,

units.source_text: 只能在六条院南部从前惯住的地方度日。

en.t: so he could only spend his days in the southern part of Rokujo-in, in the place where he had long been accustomed to living.

units.source_text: 晚上也不能离开了六女公子而赴二条院去。

en.t: At night, too, he could not leave the Sixth Princess and go to Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 因此二女公子常常望穿秋水。

en.t: Because of this, the Second Princess was always waiting for him with longing.

units.source_text: 她想：“这原是意中事，

en.t: She thought, "I had expected this from the beginning,

units.source_text: 但想不到恩情立刻完全断绝。

en.t: but I never imagined that his affection would be completely cut off at once.

units.source_text: 信乎，若是主意坚定之人，决不会忘却自身之微贱而高攀贵人。”

en.t: Truly, if I had been a person of firm resolve, I would never have forgotten my own lowly position and aspired to someone so exalted."

units.source_text: 反复思量，觉得当时贸然离开山庄，

en.t: As she thought it over again and again, she felt that her rash departure from the mountain villa at that time

units.source_text: 犹如南柯一梦，追悔莫及，悲伤不已。

en.t: had been like a dream of Nanke; she could no longer undo it and was endlessly sorrowful.

units.source_text: 又想：“还不如想个办法，悄悄地回宇治去吧。

en.t: She also thought, "It would be better to find some way to slip quietly back to Uji.

units.source_text: 并非全然和他断绝，但亦可暂时慰我衷情。

en.t: It would not mean breaking with him completely, and it might comfort my feelings for a while.

units.source_text: 只要不同他结怨，原属无妨。”

en.t: As long as I do not make him resent me, there should be no harm in it."

units.source_text: 她再三考虑之余，终于不顾羞耻，

en.t: After thinking it over again and again, she finally put shame aside

units.source_text: 写了一封信给薰中纳言，信中说道：

en.t: and wrote a letter to Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, saying:

units.source_text: “前日承为亡父举办法事，曾由阿阇梨传告，均已详悉。

en.t: "I have heard in full from the ajari that the other day you held memorial services for my late father.

units.source_text: 若非足下不忘旧谊，热诚追荐，在天之灵何等孤寂！

en.t: If you had not remembered old ties and offered such sincere prayers, how lonely his spirit in heaven would have been!

units.source_text: 拜受嘉惠，感激不尽。

en.t: I have received this gracious kindness and am endlessly grateful.

units.source_text: 如有机缘，再当面谢。”

en.t: If there is an opportunity, I will thank you in person again."

units.source_text: 这信写在陆奥纸上，不拘形式，信笔直书，然亦清秀可爱。

en.t: The letter was written on Michinoku paper, informal and freely brushed, yet still graceful and charming.

units.source_text: 已故八亲王三周年忌辰，薰中纳言替他大做功德。

en.t: On the third anniversary of the late Eighth Prince's death, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had performed many meritorious rites for him.

units.source_text: 二女公子衷心喜慰，向他道谢，虽只寥寥数语，显见真心感激。

en.t: The Second Princess was deeply comforted and pleased, and though her thanks to him were only a few words, her sincere gratitude was plain.

units.source_text: 向例二女公子对薰中纳言来信作答，尚且顾虑多端，不肯放怀详述。

en.t: Usually, even when replying to letters from Kaoru, the Second Princess had many reservations and would not open her heart in detail.

units.source_text: 此次却主动致书，并且说到“面谢”，

en.t: This time, however, she had written to him on her own initiative and even spoken of thanking him in person,

units.source_text: 薰中纳言看了受宠若惊，欢喜无量，心情大为兴奋。

en.t: so when Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, read it, he was overwhelmed by the honor, filled with joy, and greatly excited.

units.source_text: 他想起匂亲王近正贪恋新欢，遗忘故人，

en.t: He remembered that Prince Niou had lately been infatuated with his new love and had forgotten the one from before,

units.source_text: 推量二女公子定多苦痛，对她十分同情。

en.t: and he guessed that the Second Princess must be suffering greatly, so he felt deep sympathy for her.

units.source_text: 因此这信虽然言词直率，并无风趣，

en.t: For that reason, although the wording of the letter was direct and had no special elegance,

units.source_text: 薰中纳言却反复细看，爱不忍释。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, read it closely again and again, cherishing it so much that he could hardly put it down.

units.source_text: 他的回信中说：“来信拜悉。

en.t: In his reply he wrote, "I have respectfully read your letter.

units.source_text: 前日亲王三周年忌辰，小生敬怀圣僧之虔诚，前往祭奠。

en.t: On the recent third anniversary of the Prince's death, I went to offer memorial prayers, moved by reverence for the holy monk's devotion.

units.source_text: 其所以并不奉告而私自前往者，实因小姐有同行之意，而窃以为不宜也。

en.t: The reason I went privately without informing you was that you seemed inclined to accompany me, and I thought that would not be proper.

units.source_text: 来书谓我‘不忘旧谊’，未免对小生情缘估计太浅，不胜怅恨。

en.t: Your letter says that I have not forgotten old ties, but this judges my feelings far too lightly, and I cannot help feeling sorrowful resentment.

units.source_text: 余容面陈，惶恐拜复。”

en.t: I will tell you the rest in person. With deepest respect, I send this reply."

units.source_text: 这信直率地写在一张坚实的白纸上。

en.t: This letter was written plainly on a sturdy sheet of white paper.
